_rule: PROPER NOUNS ONLY — people, places, artists, institutions (04-laws.md §9). CHANGE-CONTROLLED: adding an entry requires a recorded amendment to 04-laws.md in the same PR. `lodyans`, `vwadyo`, `kapstòn` are NOT proper nouns and must never appear here (resolve by scope-add or rename — Manman gate). The v6-4 runtime whitelist violated this rule; it is not inherited.
_flaggedTokensRule: Known-unlawful Kreyòl tokens named in 04-laws.md §9 — not proper nouns, not in scope, carrying no diacritic tell, so the wordlist rules cannot catch them. Explicitly flagged until resolved by scope-add or rename (Manman gate). Removing an entry requires the resolution to be recorded in 04-laws.md.
_ambiguousTokensRule: Recorded amendment (04-laws.md §9, 2026-07-10): scope ids that are also common English words are exempt from per-token flagging in English chrome — they flag only when diacritic-bearing or matched as whole Kreyòl phrases. This list is declared openly here (the v6-4 lint hid an equivalent list in code, which the trap review forbade inheriting undeclared).
_quotedLiteratureRule: Recorded amendment (04-laws.md §9, 2026-07-11): attested proverbs/mottos quoted verbatim on a kid surface are oral literature, not coined chrome (the same exception 06-engineering.md §4 already grants the gate motto, and 04-laws.md grants Bwa Kayiman). Each entry is a documented, attested phrase — NOT a Claude coinage — rendered in guillemets with a long-press English gloss. The lint strips these exact phrases before scanning for leaked scope tokens. Adding an entry requires the phrase be attested (national motto, documented proverb) and recorded here; never a coinage or a register claim (those stay Manman-gated).
